scope: Local regression tests, mocked framework/provider boundaries, structural JSX checks and source transpilation. Not a production build, visual browser test or real transaction.

results.name: All TypeScript/TSX source files transpile without syntax errors
Commission wallet and fee policy remain unchanged
Exact 6-decimal amount shared by preflight and widget
Large, small, scientific and hex balances retain integer precision
No hidden USD floor; buffered amounts never exceed available units
Analytics buckets contain ranges, not exact wallet holdings
Zero recoveries produce zero chart height
A displayed route is distinct from an execution or completion
Changed source token and absent external selection do not discard completion
Route ownership survives tab changes and duplicate completion events
Completion without observed start is recorded and explicitly marked
Route refresh cannot unlock controls during an active transaction
User cancellation, insufficient gas and reverts are distinct
Partial cross-chain completion warns and does not auto-restart
Approvals and transfer submission are measured separately from recovery
Incomplete transaction data is never labelled ready
No provider does not imply that token approval is required
Wrong-network provider receives no eth_call or gas estimate
Preflight never asks for connection, approval or signatures
The network is rechecked before gas simulation
Obsolete asynchronous quote is discarded after cancellation
Native coin does not request a same-token same-chain quote
Sensitive arbitrary analytics fields are rejected and formulas escaped
Quote API keeps the key server-side and fixes fee/destination policy
Quote API rejects invalid chains, zero amounts, native self-swaps and foreign origin
Alchemy partial-network failures preserve successful assets
Campaign and gclid are captured before CleanUrl; tool and Google linker remain
Self-referrals are not classified as an external traffic source
Advertising identifiers stay out of the custom analytics payload
Initial UX contains no fake recoverable $0 and no LI.FI widget
Scan results without a selected asset do not render a recovery widget
Selected asset mounts one widget with the exact amount and unchanged fee
Native selection requires choosing a destination instead of self-swapping
Returning to Finder does not reset the scan results
Sharing appears after completion, not immediately after the scan
Price filters really filter without hiding unpriced assets by default
Token search, network filter and sort preserve stable object identity
Positive dust quantities do not display as zero
Selecting an asset hides the results list but preserves the selected widget
The existing LI.FI environment key is read only in the server fallback
Local previews do not send analytics or ad conversion events
Sheets transport preserves existing fields and forwards v3 event identity and time
New measurement marker is stable and never changes historical rows or credentials
Since-update filter respects the exact timestamp, client time and retains full history in day filters
Since-update requires a configured marker and supports an empty new period
Since-update period continues beyond 365 days without silently dropping its beginning
Dashboard API forwards the selected period and rejects an old backend for since-update requests
Analytics migration appends columns without changing historical rows, settings or custom columns
Analytics migration rejects incompatible headers before writing and releases its lock
Analytics persists execution stage, reason, operation ID, false and zero without sensitive fields
Analytics keeps existing authentication and does not append unauthorized events
Analytics deduplicates event IDs and repeated session stages without merging distinct operations
Conversion requires chronological events in the same session and matches execution operation IDs
Client occurrence time restores execution order when requests arrive out of order
Approval transactions are not recovery transfers and approval remains optional
Swap, bridge and unclassified generic transactions cannot inflate Finder execution
Failures and cancellations are separated by reason and retries may later succeed
Original 21-column history remains readable without fabricated operation or transfer details
Finder buckets use the first Finder scan rather than portfolio values or a later scan
Attribution waits for real values and selected tools count unique selection sessions only
Calendar window includes the first full local day and excludes older records
Calendar dates remain consecutive through daylight-saving transitions
API forwards valid client times and clears invalid, future and excessively old times
Dashboard renders all execution stages, optional approvals and separate outcome reasons
